query:
DELETE FROM rb_frontend_feature_activation f
         USING rb_frontend_revision r, rb_frontend_package p
         WHERE f.revision_id = r.id
           AND r.game_id = $1
           AND r.status = 'draft'
           AND f.package_id = p.id
           AND p.game_id = $1
           AND p.name = $2
           AND NOT (f.feature = ANY($3))
